text: "/pan-build-docs owns this policy and every handbook it references. An agent MUST regenerate the bundle rather than hand-edit a generated file."
label: incidental

text: "A Cursor-executor agent MUST use `cursor/ask_question` when it needs operator clarification or an operator decision. It needs one only under the escalation conditions `PRINCIPLES-001` states. An ordinary judgment call is made and reported, not asked.",
label: functional

text: "A brief MUST begin with an executive-summary section. COMMS-001 governs how that summary reads.",
label: functional

text: "A harness-owned drive loop MAY advance a run without starting an agent supervisor. It MUST spawn each stage worker as a top-level process and delegate through the harness path. It MUST NOT launch `pan-orchestrator` or relay the run to a child agent.",
label: incidental

text: "A missed observation is a `DELEGATE-001` violation whatever the outcome of the process. The agent MUST record the miss, the interval it left unobserved, and the reason in its report or stage output, and MUST resume the cadence at once.",
label: functional

text: "A spotfixer MUST NOT push, publish, deploy, invoke pan set-stage, or represent incomplete validation as success.",
label: incidental

text: "A supervisor MAY hold several runs of one cohort at once. It MUST reconcile each run with `pan status <run-id>` on every wake. It MUST do each run's pending action independently, so a gated or stalled run never blocks the others."
label: functional

text: "A supervisor of several concurrent runs, such as a cohort session, MUST launch the ready worker of each distinct run in one message. The platform then runs the launches in parallel, and each call stays foreground. It MUST NOT launch two workers for one run and MUST NOT exceed the cohort's recorded parallelism limit. When the platform converts one such launch into a background subagent, the supervisor MUST run `pan watch <run-id> --mark-background` for that run at once. The supervisor MUST then await the outstanding watches together.",
label: functional

text: "After any interruption, session mode change, or session wake with an active run, the supervisor MUST reconcile run state. It MUST run `pan status` before further action.",
label: functional

text: "After each group of repairs, the remediator SHOULD run the impacted iteration profile plus every test it added. In self-development that profile is `pan tests impacted`. In a target installation the remediator MUST use the target's declared impacted profile. Only when no impacted profile exists, the remediator MUST select the tests in the blast radius by judgment. Every test command MUST derive from runtime/repository-checks.json or the target's documented test entry points. The remediator MAY run the static profile freely.",
label: functional

text: "After removing and repairing, the debloater MUST run `pan models --sync`, then the resolved configuration and full repository-check profiles, the type check, and `pan debloat verify`. It MUST NOT report success while `pan debloat verify` reports `incomplete`.",
label: functional

text: "Agents MUST NOT hand-rename, hand-move, or manually rewrite generated workflow directories or records. They MUST use pan archive or the installer-owned migration path for these deterministic operations."
label: functional

text: "Agents MUST apply AUTO-001 when considering a structured deterministic operation across many files or repeated inputs.",
label: functional

text: "An operator-facing agent MUST rewrite the summary of a subagent that COMMS-001 does not bind. The rewrite MUST happen before that summary reaches the operator.",
label: incidental

text: "Before editing, the spotfixer MUST verify lightweight eligibility under WORK-001 and MUST define numbered acceptance criteria when the input does not already provide them.",
label: functional

text: "Before operator approval, four artifacts MUST run their resolved policy-bound validators under VALID-001. They are the release data, the waiver and follow-up disclosure, the diff-grounded change list, and the referenced release packet."
label: functional

text: "Before reporting success or escalation, the spotfix outcome and any escalation item MUST run their resolved policy-bound validators under VALID-001."
label: functional

text: "Before submission, prototype stage outputs MUST run their resolved policy-bound validators under VALID-001."
label: functional

text: "Before submission, the implementation claims, remediation entries, and referenced artifacts MUST run their resolved policy-bound validators under VALID-001."
label: functional

text: "Before submission, the implementation record, changed-file claims, retry-remediation evidence, acceptance evidence, and referenced summary artifact MUST run their resolved policy-bound validators under VALID-001.",
label: functional

text: "Before submission, the product-spec data and referenced operator artifact MUST run their resolved policy-bound validators under VALID-001."
label: functional

text: "Before submission, the product-spec data, engineering-plan data, acceptance-criteria traceability, open-question dispositions, and referenced plan artifact MUST run their resolved policy-bound validators under VALID-001."
label: functional

text: "Before submission, the verify data, verdict consistency, QA-case structure, acceptance-criterion coverage, and the referenced verification artifact MUST run their resolved policy-bound validators under VALID-001."
label: functional

text: "COMMS-001 governs operator-facing chat output, and GLOBAL-001 governs the durable record. An agent MUST apply each policy to its own surface.",
label: functional

text: "Designers SHOULD iterate with the screenshot-or-accessibility-snapshot → score-against-heuristics → fix-top-issues loop. BROWSER-001 governs how captures are taken and when a non-browser fallback is permitted.",
label: functional

text: "Every embedded-installation sweep finding MUST name its originating installation and queued item. This provenance rule is judgment-only, and `pan installs archive` deterministically enforces the intake-citation guard before archival.",
label: incidental

text: "Every public workflow entry point MUST run the supervisor in the operator's own session. `/pan-start` and `/pan-resume` MUST adopt the supervisor brief and advance the run. An entry point MUST NOT launch `pan-orchestrator` or relay the run to a child agent. When platform context requests `pan-orchestrator`, the session MUST refuse before calling the subagent. It MUST name `/pan-start` or `/pan-resume` instead.",
label: incidental

text: "Exclusion of a candidate MUST come from an explicit operator directive. The supervisor MUST record that exclusion with `./bin/pan best-of-n abandon`.",
label: functional

text: "For Pancreator self-development only, the release steward MUST update release metadata under VERSION-001 before operator approval. Embedded target workflows MUST remain release-metadata read-only.",
label: functional

text: "For a stage whose invocation names an external persona executor, `invoke_agent` is fulfilled by running `pan delegate <run-id>` and awaiting its result. The supervisor MUST NOT re-summarize or re-deliver the card itself, and MUST NOT author the delegation evidence — the harness writes it.",
label: functional

text: "For a worker invocation that an operator session delegated, `pan submit` MUST require a completed watch record or a foreground-return attestation. Without one it MUST fail with `DELEGATION_UNOBSERVED`, not an advisory. A worker the harness delegated is exempt only when its harness-authored delegation execution record names the run and invocation.",
label: functional

text: "GLOBAL-001 governs the durable record, and COMMS-001 governs operator-facing chat output. A record MUST obey GLOBAL-001, and a chat report MUST obey COMMS-001.",
label: functional

text: "Harness-spawned external execution is a permitted delivery mechanism: for a stage whose persona resolves to an external executor, the harness delivers the canonical card to the spawned process. The harness MUST author the delegation artifact itself. Supervisor delivery rules below bind only cursor-executor stages. The external path MUST follow EXECUTOR-001.",
label: incidental

text: "If a matching uncommitted release candidate already exists, the release steward MUST regenerate that candidate in place rather than incrementing the version again. A retry or repeated /pan-release invocation MUST be idempotent.",
label: incidental

text: "In a managed worktree the release steward MUST take proposed_version from `pan release allocate --worktree <name> --bump <bump> --run <run-id>` and MUST NOT compute it by hand. The allocation clears every version published on the worktree head, on pan-dev, and on the local default branch, and every earlier allocation. Thus two concurrent release worktrees never select the same version. A repeated allocation for one worktree returns the version it already holds.",
label: functional

text: "In self-development a spotfix that changes an installable harness input MUST be made on a worktree branch and MUST complete the release flow there (`/pan-release`) before that branch merges into `pan-dev`. It MUST NOT be committed on `pan-dev` or `main` directly, because a landing without a version is refused by `bin/check-landing` and by the installer.",
label: functional

text: "Inside a harness run the starting agent MUST use `pan watch <run-id>` as its timer and as its arming and wake record. It MUST NOT hand-arm sleeps for a run-scoped worker.",
label: functional

text: "Invocation of /pan-shepherd authorizes commits and pushes to the shepherded PR's head branch only, and only for changes whose review passed. The shepherd MUST NOT merge, close, retarget, or rebase the PR. It MUST NOT force-push or push to any other branch, and MUST NOT post PR comments unless the operator directed it.",
label: incidental

text: "The debloater MUST NOT push, publish, deploy, rewrite history, or invoke `pan set-stage`."
label: incidental

text: "The decomposition artifact MUST run its resolved policy-bound validator under VALID-001 before it is presented as complete."
label: functional

text: "The duration ceiling on the fast lane's qualified rolling daily average MUST be a release advisory and MUST NOT fail or route a stage on suite-cost grounds. A breach MUST record a run advisory and queue a performance intake for `/pan-tune-harness`. The harness MAY run mechanical structural checks on test placement and fixture construction.",
label: incidental

text: "The gate cache is harness-owned. An agent-run `pan repository-check` never consults it, so an agent gains nothing by clearing it. Agents MUST NOT set or clear PAN_GATE_CACHE. The variable leaks into any test run started from the same shell and fails the tests that cover the cache."
label: incidental

text: "The harness MUST capture executor stdout and stderr as durable run evidence under the OUTPUT-001 pattern.",
label: functional

text: "The librarian MUST write only the declared primer path and runtime/repository-checks.json. The librarian MUST NOT alter target source or workflow state. The librarian MUST validate the repository-check configuration. The librarian MUST run the primer's resolved policy-bound validator under VALID-001 before it presents the documentation bundle as complete.",
label: functional

text: "The lightweight work mode MUST run the governed spotfix workflow. Agents MAY select it only when the operator explicitly requests pan-spotfix, or a prior analysis recommends lightweight remediation under this policy.",
label: functional

text: "The merge of a completed group into its base branch is harness-owned. The harness MUST do the merge as soon as every unit run of the group is resolved. The harness MUST write the merge proof only after the merge lands cleanly. `pan cohort integrate` stays available as the retry of a failed automatic advance.",
label: incidental

text: "The meta-orchestrator MUST NOT delegate a child run to another `pan-orchestrator`, because a second-level supervisor cannot launch workers.",
label: incidental

text: "The number of concurrent unit runs MUST NOT exceed the parallelism limit recorded on the session (`pan cohort init --max-parallel`, default 4). `pan cohort start` MUST create runs only for the free slots and MUST name the deferred units. Run it again to start the deferred units once a unit run reaches a terminal state.",
label: functional

text: "The operator selection recorded by `pan debloat select` is the complete authority for what leaves. The debloater MUST NOT add a facility to it, and MUST NOT remove a facility the operator did not select except through the exclusive-reference cascade `pan debloat impact` computes.",
label: incidental

text: "The projected `pan-meta-orchestrator` agent MUST be the only start surface for a best-of-N session.",
label: functional

text: "The release steward MUST populate release.versioning with current_version, recommendation, proposed_version, baseline_commit, rationale, compatibility, updated_files, and release_index_action. current_version is the committed release version before the candidate. proposed_version is the version pan release allocate hands the worktree for the selected bump.",
label: incidental

text: "The release steward MUST read the complete release-metadata procedure this policy references. It MUST apply that procedure during every successful self-development ship stage, and whenever an operator invokes /pan-release manually.",
label: functional

text: "The repository scripts/ directory MUST NOT contain durable automation. Throwaway run-local scripts remain under runtime/logs/workflows/<run-id>/scripts/ per AUTO-001.",
label: incidental

text: "The session lifecycle MUST run through `./bin/pan best-of-n` commands. Agents MUST NOT create worktrees, candidate runs, run-scoped agent variants, or session records by hand.",
label: functional

text: "The shared instance MUST be a Chrome for Testing bundle. `pan doctor` reports whether that bundle is present and whether the server attaches over `--browserUrl`. When either is absent, agents MUST report the readiness gap rather than fall back to an installed personal browser.",
label: incidental

text: "The shepherd MUST gate each batch's change through the local review squad, by delegating one pan-shepherd-reviewer subagent. That subagent coordinates the review dimensions per the referenced squad guidance and edits nothing. A batch gets at most 3 implement-review iterations. A batch still failing after the third ends the session with nothing pushed.",
label: functional

text: "The spotfixer MUST implement the smallest coherent change and MUST add automated tests covering core functionality and likely edge cases as defined by ENG-001.",
label: functional

text: "The spotfixer MUST treat a deferred spotfix case created by a gate waiver as intake evidence, rather than pre-approved lightweight scope. It MUST independently re-verify every WORK-001 condition before editing.",
label: functional

text: "The starting agent MUST treat a foreground worker call that the platform turns into a background launch as a background subagent at once. The starting agent MUST run `pan watch <run-id> --mark-background` immediately.",
label: functional

text: "The supervising repair session MUST archive installation inbox items only after every intake it collected passes every resolved policy-bound validator. It MUST use `pan installs archive`, and MUST archive only cited harness-directed items.",
label: functional

text: "The supervisor MUST fulfill invoke_agent for an external-executor stage by running pan delegate and awaiting its result. It MUST NOT re-summarize, re-deliver, or paste the card itself.",
label: functional

text: "The supervisor MUST write the platform-guidance redline record at `/pan-start` and at each `/pan-resume`, after attesting the supervisor card, as the operator-supremacy policy requires. It MUST quote the record path in its first report. `pan prepare` and `pan submit` refuse with `REDLINE_MISSING` while the current session has no declaration.",
label: functional

text: "This policy is generated by /pan-build-docs. Agents MUST NOT hand-edit it. They MUST regenerate the bundle when detected languages or target conventions change."
label: incidental

text: "Tune state MUST live under runtime/tune-harness/ so pan archive does not move it.",
label: incidental

text: "Under OPERATOR-001, the operator MAY waive any workflow stage, gate, validation failure, or malformed or missing evidence. The operator MAY also waive a workspace-fingerprint mismatch, a harness-owned integrity stage, a retry state, or a process requirement.",
label: incidental

text: "Verification commands MUST remain under REPO-001. Agents MUST use the profiles in runtime/repository-checks.json rather than an assumed ecosystem command.",
label: functional

text: "When /pan-release finds no committed or worktree changes after the last release bump, and no release candidate needs regeneration, it MUST stop. It MUST NOT change files or increment VERSION."
label: incidental

text: "When a record has a resolved validator requirement, the record MUST pass VALID-001 before completion."
label: functional

text: "When a worker launch returns without the worker's declared output present, the supervisor MUST run `pan watch <run-id>` and await it. The supervisor MUST NOT wait for a platform completion notification instead.",
label: functional

text: "When the primer is absent or marked unbuilt, non-librarian agents MUST stop before substantive target-repository work and direct the operator to run `/pan-build-docs`. The librarian MAY create a missing primer or regenerate an existing primer."
label: functional

text: "Within a cycle the spotfixer SHOULD run only the impacted profile plus every test it added. In self-development that profile is `pan tests impacted --worktree-dirty`. In a target installation the spotfixer MUST use the target's declared impacted profile. Only when no impacted profile exists, the spotfixer MUST select the blast radius by judgment. Every test command MUST derive from runtime/repository-checks.json or the target's documented test entry points. The spotfixer MAY run the static profile freely.",
label: functional

text: "Workflow lifecycle commands — `pan submit`, `pan decide`, `pan set-stage`, `pan waive-gate`, `pan delegate` — are supervisor-owned. They live in the invocation's `<invocation-id>.supervisor.md` procedure document, never in a worker-visible contract section, and invocation validation MUST reject a worker contract that prints one. The supervisor MUST NOT deliver the procedure document to the worker.",
label: incidental

text: "Worktree removal is destructive and operator-owned. `./bin/pan best-of-n clean` MUST refuse a dirty worktree without an explicit force flag, and MUST NOT delete a branch or a commit.",
label: incidental

text: "`pan debloat select` MUST accumulate ids across calls. It MUST replace the recorded set only when the operator passes the explicit reset flag.",
label: incidental

text: "`pan submit` fails with `DELEGATION_UNOBSERVED` when a Cursor worker invocation has no completed watch record and no foreground-return attestation. After a foreground launch returns with the output present, the supervisor MUST run `pan watch <run-id> --foreground-returned` at once. When the launch returned before the output existed, the supervisor MUST await `pan watch <run-id>` instead. The supervisor MUST NOT record the attestation for a launch it did not observe return. The supervisor MUST carry a `DELEGATION_UNOBSERVED` refusal into the stage report and the run-friction intake.",
label: functional

text: "`pan watch` defaults to a 60-second cadence for every worker. The starting agent MUST NOT pass `--cadence-seconds` unless the operator directs a different cadence.",
label: incidental

text: "`pan watch` sleeps one cadence, inspects the invocation output and evidence paths, and appends each arming and wake to `agent/evidence/<invocation-id>-watch.jsonl`. The starting agent MUST await that command in the foreground until it exits.",
label: functional

It MUST launch the ready worker of each distinct run in the same message, so the launches run in parallel. It MUST keep every launch foreground.
